answer: Each identity posts a stake bond before it can attest anything, and that bond voids when its audit panel fails a diversity test, meaning three jurors resolving to one operator or one /24. Take a 40-account group registering from a single hosting block in Manila: the panel traced four of them to one ASN, the bonds voided, and the group's weight went to zero inside an epoch. Duplicates are caught by replaying payloads, not by reading names, so a rename costs the same as a copy. A beacon of signups looks like growth until the tide takes the timber.
